scenes.headline: How PanSt3R labels every view in one pass
scenes.sub: Panoptic segmentation and 3D points from loose photos
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fresnel! Here is how PanSt3R segments a whole scene from loose photos, in one forward pass.

scenes.text: One shared set of instance queries attends to every view at once, so each object gets one id across the whole scene.
scenes.say: One shared set of queries looks at every view at once, so each object gets one id across the scene.

left.title: Segment, then lift
items: Fit a NeRF or splat to reconcile
left.say: The usual way segments each image alone. The ids disagree, so a NeRF or splat is fitted for hours to fix them.

right.title: PanSt3R
items: One id per object, no poses
right.say: PanSt3R reads every view together. One id per object, and no camera poses.

steps.say: Loose photos go into two frozen networks. MUSt3R gives geometry that knows which patches are the same surface. DINOv2 gives semantics.
Their features become frame tokens, and every view's tokens join one long sequence.
Two hundred learned queries cross-attend to that whole sequence. Each query sees every view at once.
Each refined query becomes a mask in every view, and one class. Same query, same id. Nothing to match.

scenes.title: Picking which masks to keep
scenes.text: max sum u_i A_i - lambda sum u_i u_j O_ij
scenes.say: The raw masks overlap, so the paper picks a subset with one binary optimisation over the scene.

parts.note: coverage: the area of each chosen mask
parts.say: Every chosen mask earns its area, summed over all views.

parts.note: a cost for every overlapping pair
parts.say: Every overlapping pair costs its overlap, times a penalty.

steps.say: With the standard merge, a duplicate can outbid the real object, and black void blocks appear.
With QUBO choosing over the whole scene, most holes fill in.

scenes.title: ScanNet scene PQ, paper Table 2
scenes.note: PanSt3R's row also needs a 35 minute splat to render test views
scenes.say: On ScanNet the paper reports sixty five point seven, ahead of the lifting methods. But rendering the test views needs a splat that takes thirty five minutes.

scenes.text: Move the reconciliation into attention: queries that see every view give ids that agree by construction.
scenes.say: Move the reconciliation into attention. Queries that see every view give ids that agree by construction.

recap: Frozen MUSt3R and DINOv2 tokens from all views
200 shared queries, one id per object
QUBO picks masks; the v2 weights skip it
scenes.say: Frozen features from all views, shared queries, and a merge for the whole scene.
